description: 【京都府】道路現況(道路実延長) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 京都府. 京都府統計書 第６章 道路・建設･住宅. Coverage: 京都府. The portal files it under the publisher 京都府. Its tags are 京都府政策企画部, 企画統計課, 統計書, 道路_建設_住宅, ３つ星オープンデータ. It offers 38 resource(s) in csv, rdf, xls, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-04-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
